description:
*FREE GUIDE: 📘 The Content Creator's AI Blueprint –* https://FirstMovers.ai/blueprint/

*Jack Dorsey just cut 4,000 people in 3 weeks — and the reason he gave changes how every business owner should think about AI layoffs in 2026.*

He didn't call it restructuring. He didn't call it rightsizing. **He called it "honest."**

Block dropped 40% of its workforce after a 3-week internal experiment with **Claude Opus 4.6 and OpenAI Codex 5.3**. Meta cut 8,000. Microsoft over 6,000. Over **150,000 tech jobs gone YTD 2026**.

Inside this breakdown:
• Why the *AI layoff euphemisms* just ended — and what CEOs are saying out loud now
• The *Goldman Sachs scar data* that tracks displaced workers 10 years out
• What *Stanford's 2026 AI Index* revealed about agent task success rates
• Three moves to make this quarter to land on the *right side of the curve*

What does it actually look like to be on the winning side of the *AI layoff wave* over the next 18 months?
